csv_project_name: Developer for NW 7th AveDevelopment Tucker Hill Section 3
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Ocala ( City ), through this Invitation to Negotiate ( ITN ) GRM/260684, seeks proposals from interested and qualified developers, builders, partnerships and/or agencies interested in constructing a residential development on the subject parcels to include a mix of single-family detached residential homes and an open space area. The City s intent is to use the property for the creation of Affordable Housing while maintaining quality construction and site design. The catalytic site proposed for redevelopment consists of multiple parcels (the "Property") with a total area of approximately 2.01 acres .
